primaryFormatSpecifications.acquisition: curl -fL followed HTTP308 redirect; selected specification sections extracted after installing fonttools

primaryFormatSpecifications.scope: Released schema examined as a historical primary schema; parser/writer behavior and Version compatibility paths override assuming current complete schema conformance.

versions.claim: Legacy namespace/version IDs V1–V14 are recognized by the version map; the writer emits v10.dtd namespace with separate Version metadata. Do not relabel the emitted XML namespace v14 merely because Gnumeric is 1.12.61.
Writer uses v10.dtd; compressed and uncompressed savers are separate; .xml suffix disables compression in the normal saver.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: Workbook/sheet/cell/style/name/print/object parser node registrations are individually censused; gzip and legacy encoding conversions are explicit input paths. Registration is not a fidelity claim.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: Unsupported sheet-object types produce an explicit error-info entry; unknown filter types/operators warn.

lossWarnings.claim: Multiple namespace version specifications warn; old row/column-size compatibility uses application version metadata and optional GNM_HACK_COLROW.

versions.claim: Text import supports separated/fixed-width parser modes, with guessing in the noninteractive opener; no named CSV format version establishes fidelity.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: Text exporter whitelist: eol, charset, locale, quote, separator, format, transliterate-mode, quoting-mode, quoting-on-whitespace; common sheet/active-sheet handling is delegated.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: formulas is absent from the whitelist and common handler; invalid keys error. Released manpage omits formulas; current master manpage describes it. Oracle observes rejection for true/false.

lossWarnings.claim: Encoding conversion, date formatting and automatic/raw/preserve paths are source-visible; iconv availability and transliteration behavior require the pinned dependency profile.

versions.claim: BOF decoder distinguishes BIFF2/3/4/7/8 and maps selected BOF words; reporting refers to Excel5/95/97+. This is version dispatch, not complete BIFF coverage. Savers expose BIFF7, BIFF8 and double-stream output.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: Worksheet dispatch routes DIMENSIONS_v2, NUMBER/RK, BOOLERR, FORMULA variants and LABELSST; workbook dispatch routes SST/EXTSST and FILEPASS. Shared/array formula implementation is separately cited.
Shared/array formula records are parsed through dedicated handlers.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: DDE/OLE link names warn that they will be lost.

limits.doubleStream: Writer caps using BIFF7 row bound when writing that sheet representation; see excel_sheet_new.

lossWarnings.claim: BIFF importer retains selected CompObj/VBA/OLE structured streams as blobs; no macro execution or blanket macro fidelity is established.

versions.claim: Saver manifests name ECMA-376 first edition (2006) and ISO/IEC29500:2008/ECMA second edition (2008). Import namespaces include 2006 main and a Microsoft 2009/9 alias. Both audit outputs used 2006 main namespace; that alone does not distinguish strict conformance.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: ZIP content probe requires xl/workbook.xml; XML parser tables enumerate cells/styles/shared strings/comments/drawings/charts. The manifest also names xlsb as a suffix, but this does not identify a binary workbook decoder.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: Importer TODOs explicitly include conditional format improvements and hard-coded width issues. Every node with NULL callbacks needs a preservation/ignored-content review.
Unhandled conditional format types warn and are ignored; invalid data validation warns.

defaultReferenceGrid.primarySpecification: ECMA-376 first edition Part4 3.17.7.1: default A1–XFD1048576 range; implementations may extend it, with explicit defined-name precedence rules.

limits.nativeWriterGrid: XLSX_MAX_COLS/ROWS use the actual sheet maxima, not an unconditional1M-row cap.

lossWarnings.claim: Known namespace aliases do not prove support for arbitrary future namespaces or every extension element.

versions.claim: Manifest describes the 2003 XML format as an opener only; it is distinct from OOXML ZIP services.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: Workbook/Worksheet/Table/Row/Cell/Data registrations and rich-text child handlers are explicit source dispatch points.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: NamedCell is registered with NULL callbacks; unknown node semantics and preservation are unresolved, not a claim of complete XML support.

versions.claim: Export version is supplied by libgsf gsf_odf_get_version/version_string, not hardcoded from the filename or saver name. Audit profile emits office:version=1.2 for both savers.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: mimetype is first and uncompressed; content.xml/styles.xml/meta.xml/settings.xml and manifest/pictures are separate streams. Extended versus strict-style saver mode is with_extension, separate from version.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: Foreign extension handling and version-dependent attributes are explicit in writer paths; registration alone cannot prove lossless strict output.

versions.claim: HTML3.2/4.0, full XHTML and range/fragment services are distinct source declarations; they are not a browser CSS/JavaScript implementation contract.
Full LaTeX/table/table-visible and TROFF savers are distinct write-only services; scope and sheet-selection attributes are retained.
PO saver is in the WITH_PYTHON example directory and is absent from the primary plugin installation. That is a build-profile condition, not an interactive-only declaration.
No numeric version is declared by the service; import reads TABLE/DATA topics and value records.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: V numeric, NA, TRUE, FALSE and quoted string paths are handled. Header TABLE name is read but not applied (FIXME).

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: ERROR value token warns and is ignored; unknown value types warn/ignore. Excess rows/columns warn and remaining data is ignored.

limits.rowAndColumnBound: gnm_sheet_get_max_rows/cols; off-by-one and boundary behavior require original cases

lossWarnings.claim: Unexpected EOF during header/data becomes an import error.

versions.claim: Service is SYLK; specific directive/option handling is more precise than a blanket SYLK version promise.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: Top-level B is ignored; C/E/F/P/O/W route to distinct handlers; NN and ID have separate prefix paths.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: Unknown directives warn and continue; missing closing E warns. Several style/options warn as unhandled; record dispatch is not full preservation.

lossWarnings.claim: Multiple values/expressions in a cell warn through sylk_read_warning.

versions.claim: Reader describes versions4/5; header rejects v0<400 and encodings other than 7BIT. It does not impose an upper version bound there.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: 3D array functions are not supported; out-of-range contents warn/ignore.

lossWarnings.claim: Unknown number-format and cell-type paths warn.

versions.claim: Probe checks the Spreadsheet Calculator banner; this does not establish an SC/xspread revision matrix.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: Source creates a 256-column/65536-row SC sheet, ISO-8859-1 conversion and SC expression conventions.

versions.claim: Source uses Oleo command records and R1C1 conventions; no validated revision acceptance matrix exists.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: Cell expressions can be retained even when values are absent; limited formatting supports alignment and numeric/percent output.

versions.claim: Reader dispatches original123/Symphony/Symphony2 to old parser; 123V4/V6/V7/SS98 to new parser. Unexpected Lotus versions warn and use new parser. WORKS_VERSION_3 selects Works parser, other Works versions return false.
Probe accepts version words 0x1001/0x1002/0x1006/0x1007; comments explicitly question the 6.0/7.0 interpretation. Do not silently turn those comments into a proven revision matrix.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: Unsupported QPro function mappings have explicit warning paths.

versions.claim: Probe matches a ten-byte WPC/PlanPerfect signature. Major/minor version bytes are documented in the comment, but excluded from that signature match.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: Column-format record0x03 adjusts widths/styles; record0x02 currently breaks without applying its documented properties.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: Unknown preliminary records are silently ignored; undefined formula codes warn; source user documentation reports most formatting information lost.

versions.claim: Importer depends on Psiconv; unchanged released plugin failed to compile against the recorded author Psiconv0.9.9 profile. No qualified optional runtime exists.
Service identifies xBase, but decoder behavior is determined by field types/codepages/header parsing, not all DBF dialects.

supportedOrHandledRecords.claim: C/N/L/D/I/F field paths handle text/numeric/logical/date/int32/double values; invalid dates remain strings.

rejectedIgnoredOrLostRecords.claim: B field explicitly warns BINARY does not work; unsupported field types become marker strings. Unknown codepage warns and falls back to ISO-8859-1.

lossWarnings.claim: Unrepresentable characters can be replaced by question marks with a warning; invalid logical values warn.

versions.claim: Library pxlib determines file version support; source does not establish an exhaustive Paradox revision matrix. Primary installed service is distinct from successful fixture qualification.
